sections.title: Report basis
sections.sql: select p.ref,p.status,p.base_date,p.source,p.scope,p.assumptions,p.exclusions,p.uncertainty_pct,p.index_series,p.price_index,p.author,p.reviewed_by,j.currency,j.area_m2 from plans p join projects j on j.id=p.project_id where p.id=$1

sections.title: Elements
sections.sql: select code,description,quantity,unit,rate as unit_rate_amount,amount as budget_amount from cost_lines where plan_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Summary
sections.note: Contingency is a stated percentage of base cost. Tax and currency conversion are not calculated.
sections.sql: select currency,base_amount,contingency_amount,total_amount,rate_per_m2 as area_rate_amount from plan_totals where id=$1

name: tender-reconciliation
title: Draft tender reconciliation
for_each: select distinct p.id,p.ref from plans p join tenders t on t.plan_id=p.id

sections.title: Scope coverage and price
sections.sql: select supplier,currency,priced_lines,line_count,tender_amount,base_amount,variance_amount,coverage from tender_summary where plan_id=$1 order by supplier

sections.title: Tender source records
sections.sql: select supplier,line_code,amount,source,received_date from tenders where plan_id=$1 order by supplier,line_code

sections.title: Record findings
sections.note: A clean checklist is not RICS certification or professional sign-off.
sections.sql: select rule,finding from compliance_findings where plan_id=$1
